changes.title: Pipeline spare capacity revised for Nov 2027

changes.balance: Looser: more room before the pipes bind.
changes.vintage: 2026-09-28 (F3 rail-baseload split before the pipe cap; F5 economic inventory path; inventory floor + shortage-side price response; barrel-conservation invariant)
